title: PFO-associé AVC Causal Likelihood (PASCAL) classification System
abbreviations: PASCAL Classification for PFO-Associated Stroke Causal Likelihood
formula:
The PASCAL classification system combines the Risk of Paradoxical Embolism [(RoPE)](nabda:calc.risk-paradoxical-embolism-rope-score) Score with the presence or absence of high-risk PFO features detected on transesophageal echocardiogram (TEE): large shunt size (LS) and/or atrial septal aneurysm (ASA).

- LS was defined in the database as >20 bubbles in the left atrium on transesophageal echo.
- ASA was defined as ≥10 mm of excursion from midline.

- Améliore le [Score RoPE](nabda:calc.risk-paradoxical-embolism-rope-score) en ajoutant une anatomie du PFO à haut risque.

how_to_use.when:
- Use for adults ≤60 years with an embolic-appearing, otherwise cryptogenic ischemic stroke in whom a PFO has been identified after a complete diagnostic work-up to rule out alternative causes.
- This study did not include patients with rare but extremely high-risk conditions such as those with concomitant DVT or thrombus straddling PFO.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Derived and validated in 18–60-year-olds with non-lacunar ischemic stroke; applicability to patients >60 years or isolated TIA is uncertain.
- Unlikely category (~15-18% of the cohort) showed no clinical benefit from PFO closure.
- Probable category experienced ~90% relative risk reduction in recurrent stroke with device closure.
- Does not replace a thorough evaluation for competing causes (e.g., prolonged rhythm monitoring for atrial fibrillation, vascular imaging, labs).
- The magnitude of benefit on functional outcomes after PFO closure is uncertain.

next_steps.advice: La sélection des patients en vue d’une fermeture du FOP doit faire l’objet d’une décision partagée entre la neurologie et la cardiologie, en intégrant les résultats de PASCAL à l’ensemble du bilan diagnostique.
next_steps.critical_actions: Always exclude other or contributing stroke mechanisms (e.g., atrial fibrillation, hypercoagulable states) before attributing causality to the PFO.
next_steps.management:
Si la probabilité que l'AVC soit attribuable à un PFO est classée comme :

- **Possible ou probable :** Envisager une fermeture du PFO en prévention secondaire.
- **Peu probable :** Se concentrer sur les étiologies alternatives et une prise en charge antithrombotique et des facteurs de risque vasculaire guidée par les recommandations ; la fermeture pourrait ne pas être bénéfique.

evidence:
Patients in the **Unlikely** category had a HR of 1.14 (95% CI, 0.53-2.46) and a 2-year absolute risk reduction of −0.7% (95% CI, −4.0% to 2.6%) for recurrent ischemic stroke.

Patients in the **Possible** category had a HR of 0.38 (95% CI, 0.22-0.65) 2-year absolute risk reduction of 2.1% (95% CI, 0.6%-3.6%) for recurrent ischemic stroke.

Patients in the **Probable** category had a HR of 0.10 (95% CI, 0.03-0.35) and 2-year absolute risk reduction of 2.1% (95% CI, 0.9%-3.4%) for recurrent ischemic stroke.
